turns.question: For leads that turned into a booking in September 2026, what was the median number of days from lead creation to booking?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no metric for the median (or any) number of days from lead creation to booking, so I cannot give that figure. The closest metrics are Bookings (bookings made by leads, on the day they were made) and Lead-to-booking rate (share of leads that booked within 30 days of being created, counted on the lead's creation day); I can query either for September 2026 if that helps.
